name: superdesign
description: Design or redesign frontend UI and graphics on the Superdesign canvas with a choice of leading AI models. Use whenever the user wants to design a page, feature, flow, or brand-new product; improve or reproduce existing UI; compare design results across top models; explore visual variants; set or extract a design system; build reusable components or multi-page flows; or create posters and marketing graphics, even if they never say the word 'design tool'. Also supports generating supporting image
author: superdesigndev
summary_zh: 一款集成多种主流 AI 模型的设计画布，适合快速生成、改版和对比界面，搭建设计系统、多页流程及营销素材。
